notes: Velocity limits come from AR4 HMI minSpeedDelay, virtual_speed_scale, and steps/degree.
Acceleration limits are torque/inertia estimates derived from public AR4 motor and transmission specs.
Stepper holding torque is a zero-speed value, so the planner uses motorTorqueDerate for torque-speed margin.
Equivalent joint inertia is a package assumption and should be replaced by measured/CAD mass properties when available.
motionLimitDerivation.limitProfileDescription: Torque-derived AR4 planner limits before stress-test scaling.

drivetrains.source: StepperOnline AR4-MK4/5 J5 linear stepper page

mountingHoles.comment: Four external AR4 pedestal mounting-hole centers fitted from complete cylindrical rings in the full-resolution Link Base-2 STL. The internal 2 by 6 enclosure pattern and sidewall holes are excluded.
